title: X-Tun X-Koh (Sistema Actun Koh line plot) - Up Loop part
credits: X-Tun X-Koh: line plot of Sistema Actun Koh (Puerto Aventuras), Up Loop 4,068 ft and Down Loop 2,108 ft, grid in feet from station 0 at Cenote Actun Koh; author and date not on the map. Filed as 'X-tun and X-koh, Ejo. Pino Suarez' from wetworx.nl/Cavemaps (accessed May 2015).
placementWhy: Moderate (about 10-20 m; it inherits the placement of the Mafia Maps 1998 plan, maps/actun-koh-mafia.json, itself tied to the Expedition Yuc 96 map). This line plot is the same survey area as that plan (Bear's Den, Attic, Dreamland, Section Six, Wonderland, Teens; X at station 0 = 'Cenote Actun Koh p. 0'), but its two halves don't fit one placement: matching its lines to the Mafia plan's (ICP), the Down Loop part fits with 0.603 m/px and 5.7 degrees (93% of the line within 8 m, median 2.4 m), the Up Loop part with 0.669 m/px and 10.1 degrees (median 5 m) - one placement for the whole plot leaves 20-50 m errors at the far ends. The Expedition Yuc 96 walls (an independent survey) agree with the Mafia plan, so the error is in this plot, probably on the main line between the Up Loop and station 0 (the grid itself is unequal too: 123.5 px per 250 ft across, 118 px up). The map is therefore placed in two parts: this config (the Up Loop part, north of y 1062 and Dreamland) and maps/x-koh-down-loop.json. Free similarity fit on six points: Bears' Den X on the Mafia plan's Bear's Den Cenote (= Yuc 96 Cenote Dedale), residual 12 m (the X is drawn beside the line), and five Up Loop corners and junctions read off the placed Mafia plan's lines, residuals 2-6 m. The grid's own scale (0.62-0.645 m/px) and north are not used: they disagree with both placed surveys by 4-10% and 6-10 degrees.
